page.overview:
Who is Nyctelios?

Nyctelios is a fictional entity created by Patrick Bosquet for the Call of Cthulhu scenario "Le Regard Dans L'Abime", featured in issue #87 of the French role-playing magazine Casus Belli.

Nyctelios was originally one of the Elder Gods, but was punished by Nodens for transgressions against his brethren, ultimately becoming an Outer God who was imprisoned under the Mediterranean Sea. He takes the form of a grotesque, muscular cyclops-like humanoid, whose body is infested with hideous worms. One day, he will rise from the abyssal citadel he was ensnared in and seek revenge upon the Elder Gods.
